neper.notes: The baseline: round glyph buttons (control.glyph_toggle); the sheet's first cell is one row of them.

windows.notes: Measured at 100 % from the live main window (ref/windows/toolbar_button.png = the left two bars of the second toolbar row, x 8..454, y 84..109; windows/toolbar_button-vs-ref.png). Strip 26 tall: #F5F5F5 line above, #BEBEBE and #D2D2D2 lines below, a #FFFFFF left line (#F3F3F3 on the next bar), a closed bar ends in a #AAAAAA line; grip = two lines of (white, face, #A0A0A0) 3 px each at x 4 and 7 (#F2F2F2/#ABABAB beside another bar), rows 1..23, end rows #BDBDBD/#D2D2D2. Buttons 23 wide (16 px picture, 3.5 each side) from x 11, separators 6 wide (#A3A3A3 + #FCFCFC lines at +2/+3, 21 tall). Bar A = 2+2+1+3 buttons in 215 px, bar B = 4+2+3 in 232 px: every line, separator and grip pixel column matches the capture. Disabled picture drawn as a #C8C8C8 glyph (v3: pale bitmap, mean #D4D4D4).
gaps: Enabled pictures: v3 draws coloured bitmaps (grey funnel, blue binoculars, house, Discord...), a drawn single-colour glyph stands in, so the enabled rest state is geometry-only
Hover, pressed and checked colours (light blues #CCE8FF / #A8D4F8 family) are guesses: no capture shows them
Separator tone drifts #A3 to #AF along the row in v3 (a horizontal gradient), drawn flat #A3A3A3
No keyboard focus look (DX bars are not focusable)
Button height 22 is a guess (the capture shows only the 16 px picture, rows 88..104)
Captioned buttons use Tahoma 12 px; no capture of a captioned v3 button
Dropdown arrow button and toolbar customisation drag handle not drawn
Neper sheet row differs from before: cell 0 is one row of round glyphs
Dark and high-contrast palettes keep Neper colours

neper.notes: The baseline: v2 menu bar (the open-menu sheet shows no menu because the menu fades in).

windows.notes: Measured at 100 % from the live main window (ref/windows/menu_bar.png = x 8..789, y 31..56; windows/menu_bar-vs-ref.png). Strip 26 tall: #FFFFFF dock line, #F5F5F5 line, #F0F0F0 face, #BCBCBC and #DEDEDE lines below that start right of the grip (the grip runs through them, as v3 draws it), grip lines at x 4 and 7. Titles Tahoma 12 px (the DFM's -12), ink 3 rows below the dock: cap rows 8..16, underline rows 18 (full) and 19 (35 %), black on the face; padding 6.25 each side (fitted: the ten title starts are within 2 px of the capture: 17 46 87 136 175 203 232 278 332 373 419 against ours 17 48 90 138 176 204 232 278 331 372 418). Mnemonics as v3: F C S V, Card A(rt), O R T, A d(min), H; written `&File` ... `A&dmin` in the label (the Windows branch strips the `&`, a title with no `&` underlines its first letter).
gaps: Hover and pressed title colours are guesses (light blues)
Open title drawn as a flat #AFAFAF box, the capture shows no open menu
v3 text is ClearType (colour fringes) and GDI-hinted; ours is grey anti-aliased and unhinted, so glyph pixels differ and title starts drift up to 2 px
The dock's right border (#C5C5C5 at x 791) is not part of the bar
Collapsed menu bar keeps the Neper look
Dark and high-contrast palettes keep Neper colours
windows_bar_theme now sets Tahoma 12 px for every bar text (was 11.7 fitted at 150 %), which also nudges popup_menu rows

windows.notes: Measured at 100 % from the live main window (ref/windows/status_bar.png = x 8..791, y 574..592; windows/status_bar-vs-ref.png). Bar 19 tall: #D4D4D4 line above, #FFFFFF below, panels 17 tall between (rows 1..17: #BBBBBB top line, #F5F5F5 bottom line), panels one px apart: 282 | 153 | the rest (item.panel_width, item.fills); each has a dark left line (#A0A0A0, #ADADAD, #B5B5B5: a gradient along x, 160 + 0.047 x) with a #E3E3E3 line beside it on all but the first, and a #FCFCFC + #F3F3F3 pair at its right; every seam column matches the capture. Text Tahoma 10.8 px (ink 262 px for the counts string: 9..270), first panel centred (the DFM: taCenter), the others start 3 px in ('Idle' ink at x 439). Size grip: 3 diagonal strokes (lead #F3F3F3, then #E9E9E9 #BDBDBD #AEAEAE #DADADA repeating) over 12 rows and 13 columns, drawn pixel for pixel from the capture (identical).
gaps: Progress container panel (grey track, #06B025 fill) is a guess: the capture shows it empty
v3 text is ClearType (colour fringes); ours is grey anti-aliased
Panel widths come from the caller (item.panel_width / fills); without them panels hug their text (as before)
A narrow bar clips the last panel instead of eliding
Hover colour of a pressable panel is a guess
Dark and high-contrast palettes keep Neper colours
